subject: Geography
pacing_note: The IEB publishes no ATP equivalent; term placement and week spans are the DBE ATP pacing carried over as a default. IEB schools set their own pacing — treat weeks as advisory.
assessment_note: DBE SBA programmes, control-test scopes and exam structures are deliberately stripped: IEB assessment is specified by the IEB Subject Assessment Guidelines (see ../exam_guidelines/), which have not been ingested yet. Do not fall back to the CAPS exam_structure for IEB papers.

topics.name: Earth’s energy balance
subtopics: Consolidation of Grade 10 climatology; unequal heating of the atmosphere (latitudinal and seasonal)
Significance of the earth's axis and revolution around the sun
Transfer of energy and the energy balance
Mapwork: aerial photographs/orthophotos, 1:50 000 referencing, 16 cardinal points

topics.name: Global air circulation
subtopics: Global air circulation as a response to unequal heating; world pressure belts; tri-cellular circulation
Relationships between air temperature, air pressure and wind
Pressure gradient, Coriolis force and geostrophic flow; westerlies, tropical and polar easterlies
Air-mass characteristics; regional and local winds; monsoons and Föhn winds

topics.name: Africa’s weather and climate
subtopics: Subsidence and convergence linked to rainfall
The role of oceans in climate control in Africa
El Niño and La Niña (basic knowledge, not for examination)
Reading and interpreting synoptic weather maps; GIS and remote sensing applied to climatology

topics.name: Droughts and desertification
subtopics: Causes of droughts; causes of desertification
Effects of droughts and desertification on people and the environment
Management strategies (case studies)
Mapwork/GIS: drought-prone area maps, desertification infographics, spatial objects and scales

topics.name: Horizontally layered rocks
subtopics: Hilly landscapes and basaltic plateaux: characteristics and processes
Scarp retreat and back wasting
Canyon and Karoo landscapes
Mapwork: map scale, contours and landforms, cross-sections, vertical exaggeration, gradient

topics.name: Inclined/tilted rock strata
subtopics: Scarp and dip slopes; cuesta, homoclinal ridge, hogsback, cuesta basin and cuesta dome
Mapwork: contours, cross-sections, vertical exaggeration, gradient

topics.name: Massive igneous rocks
subtopics: Identification of batholiths, laccoliths, lopoliths, dykes and sills
Granite domes and tors: characteristics and processes
Mapwork: gradient, intervisibility, vertical exaggeration

topics.name: Slopes
subtopics: Overview of SA topography; types of slopes
Slope elements: crest, cliff (scarp/free face), talus (debris/scree), pediment
Characteristics of slope elements; the concept of slope retreat
GIS: spatial and spectral resolution; line, point, area and attribute data; raster vs vector

topics.name: Mass movement
subtopics: Concept and kinds of mass movement: soil creep, solifluction, landslides, rock falls, mud flows, slumps
Impact on people and the environment
Prevention/minimisation strategies with South African case studies

topics.name: Development
subtopics: Terminology and the concept of development
Developed vs developing; MEDCs, LEDCs and industrial countries
Mapwork: locating exact position (degrees, minutes, seconds)

topics.name: Framework for development
subtopics: Economic, social, sustainable, appropriate-scale and spatial aspects of development
Indicators: GNP, GDP, HDI, Gini coefficient, life expectancy, infant mortality
Local, regional and global examples of development differences

topics.name: Trade and development
subtopics: International trade and world markets; commodities traded; terms of trade
Types of trading relationships
Globalisation and its impact on development
Export-led development, critically examined with world examples

topics.name: Development issues and challenges
subtopics: Factors affecting development: access to resources, energy, history, trade imbalances, population growth, education and training, natural-resource limits, environmental degradation (complex, interrelated)
Community-based development; rural and urban approaches (case studies)
The effect of development on the environment

topics.name: Role of development aid
subtopics: Concept of development aid and development co-operation
Types of aid: technical, conditional, humanitarian
Impact of aid on development (positive and negative case studies)

topics.name: Soil and soil erosion
subtopics: Causes of soil erosion: human, animal, physical; past and present
Evidence of soil erosion in South Africa; effects on people and the environment
Management strategies to prevent and control soil erosion
GIS: spatially referenced data; spatial and spectral resolution; line/point/area data

topics.name: Conventional energy sources
subtopics: Thermal and hydro-energy production in South Africa (maps and graphs)
Thermal electricity generation using coal: principles and processes
Impact of coal mining and thermal power stations: advantages and disadvantages
SA's potential to meet long-term energy needs conventionally; nuclear energy case study

topics.name: Non-conventional energy sources
subtopics: Solar energy: SA and world examples
Wind energy: SA and world examples
The future of non-conventional energy in SA; effects on economy and environment

topics.name: Energy management in South Africa
subtopics: Energy management towards greener economies and sustainable lifestyles: responsibilities of government, businesses and individuals
